name: Xbalanque
subtitle: The War Twin
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Xbalanque and his twin brother Hunahpu are the offspring of Xquic—an underworld goddess—and a slain mortal. Through wits, physical prowess, and divine favors, they adventured against demons and gods, eventually avenging their father on the underworld deities who slew him. In Ryven they continue to oppose the death gods, and to thwart the monsters who threaten Omeyocan’s people.
divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when this hero or Hunahpu inflict damage to an enemy

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Jaguar Strike
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (11%HP+160%ATK). If the target has higher MAX HP than this hero, inflict an additional 1% Enemy Max HP. If Hunahpu is on the team, place [mechanic:sharpen-ii] on this hero for 2 turns before attacking.

skills.name: Xibalba Trickery
skills.description: Attack all enemies (10%HP+120%ATK). If the attack is a Strong hit, has a 50% chance to place [mechanic:stun] on the target for 1 turn. If Hunahpu is on the team, increase his Divinity by 20%.

skills.name: Moon Javelin
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (9%HP+150%ATK) with a 50% chance to place [mechanic:def-down-ii] on the target for 1 turn. If Hunahpu is on the team, he joins the attack.

skills.name: Twin Duelist
skills.description: When this hero inflicts a critical attack, the next attack will inflict 20% increased damage. If Hunahpu is on the team, will inflict 40% instead.

imprint_passive: When this hero inflicts a critical attack, the next attack will inflict 10% increased damage.
